title: Translate PrimeFlex classes to Tailwind CSS

path.description: Restrict the translation to files under this workspace path (e.g. "src/app"). Defaults to the whole workspace.

tailwindVersion.description: The Tailwind CSS major version to produce class names for. Tailwind v4 renamed the shadow and border-radius scales. Defaults to the version of the tailwindcss dependency, or 4 when Tailwind is not installed yet.
